# awscc_lambda_web_function_revision (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::Lambda::WebFunctionRevision



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `build_config` (Attributes) The build configuration for the revision. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--build_config))
- `created_at` (String) The timestamp when the revision was created.
- `description` (String) A description of the revision.
- `function_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the function.
- `function_name` (String) The name of the web function this revision belongs to. The length constraint applies only to the full ARN. If you specify only the function name, it is limited to 64 characters in length.
- `kms_key_arn` (String) The ARN of the KMS key used to encrypt the revision.
- `revision_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the revision.
- `revision_id` (String) The unique identifier of the revision.
- `service_config` (Attributes) The service configuration for the revision. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--service_config))
- `state` (String) The current state of the revision.
- `state_reason` (String) The reason for the revision's current state.
